record.body:
## Description

R1: `orchestra/canon/backend.py` defines a `Backend` protocol that declares every storage operation its callers use.
R2: `Store` implements `Backend` with its on-disk layout unchanged.
R3: `open_store` obtains its backend from `open_backend`.
R4: `open_backend` returns the file backend when the store config has no `backend` key.
R5: No module in `orchestra/canon/` other than the file backend builds a path under the store root.
R6: No signature in `Backend` takes or returns a file path.

## Approach

Read every storage caller. Add a path-free Backend protocol and open_backend factory. Preserve Store public compatibility for existing tests, move layout integrity checks into Store, and expose logical record/history/op/schema operations required by Project, validation, migration, merge and sync. Route CLI and Project through factory/protocol. Preserve file format and existing behavior; no SQLite in this phase.

payload.title: Introduce the backend protocol and file factory; route canon internals through it
